findings.location: Article body, paragraph beginning “One specific thing…”
findings.source_quote: “broken relationships and emotional/mental struggles within the plain communities”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “emosionele/geestelike probleme” with “emosionele-/geestesgesondheidsprobleme” to convey emotional and mental-health struggles, not spiritual problems.
findings.translation_quote: “gebroke verhoudings en emosionele/geestelike probleme binne die plain-gemeenskappe”

findings.source_quote: “For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “maar aan sy siel skade ly” with “maar sy eie siel verloor” so the quotation says that the person loses their soul, rather than suffers harm to it.
findings.translation_quote: “Want wat baat dit ’n mens as hy die hele wêreld win, maar aan sy siel skade ly?”

findings.location: Article body, paragraph beginning “One specific thing…”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a clear Afrikaans rendering of “plain communities” appropriate to the community meant, rather than leaving “plain” in English; for example, “binne die konserwatiewe Anabaptistiese gemeenskappe” if that is the intended reference.
